posts.subject: Little change for minigame
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello,


I just want to suggest a little change to the no weapon fix plugin on minigames. This modified version just give an incendiary nade and not a decoy anymore. It will allow players to take bonus nades and some others stuff they couldn't take before.


Link :

I will test the plugin later today, thanks for the modification 🙂


EDIT: Sorry, the plugin has a bug, so it won't be added in the current way.
What happens is, after you pick a real (fake) decoy, you'll recieve a real incendiary grenade, which you can then throw to damage people.

#doppelpost


I've fixed the issue by updating to the newest version of the "No weapon fix" plugin, which has the option to use healthshots instead of decoys, so there shouldn't be any issues on Minigame maps now.


Thanks for trying to fix it though [;)]
